== Article notes ==

=== Missing data ===
* Another Pathetic Lifeform (V) is a Light Side Defensive Shield slip in this PDF. It has no wiki page and is not in the Virtual Shields or Virtual Block card lists, so it is unlinked.
* Rebel Fleet (V): the cover says it will return in Virtual Set 7, but it is not in the 7.1 to 7.4 release PDFs.
=== Build notes ===
* Card list taken from the slip captions in [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf] (the title above each slip, not the original-card label in its corner); links follow the [[Virtual Block 6]] card list. Sides come from the PDF's Dark Side and Light Side pages.
* The PDF file was created on 20 April 2010; its cover gives the text as of 4 September 2009.
* Defensive Shield slips printed more than once (one per original shield, for example Reflections III, Premium and Death Star II versions) are listed once.
* Article created as a test for Bill; title uses the "(Virtual Block N)" suffix for all twelve releases because Domain Of Evil, Scoundrels and Republic At War already have pages. Source PDF not yet saved to the Internet Archive (queued).
